document.title: Run eval producers and graders in Muse Code
document.summary: The eval harness gains an optional Muse Code agent for the producer and grader roles. Each role selects cursor or musecode independently, and Muse runs go through a new headless runner.
document.why: The user wants eval producers and graders able to run in Muse Code as well as Cursor, using MUSE_CODE_API_KEY.

sources.label: Muse Code session · Sep 26
sources.gist: The user asked to run eval producers and graders optionally in Muse Code using MUSE_CODE_API_KEY, then to run one eval on Muse and open this PR.

groups.title: Muse Code runner
groups.why: This group is the foundation the agent wiring group calls. It enables that group.
groups.summary: Spawns headless `muse exec --json` with the prompt in a temp file and the API key on stdin, then parses the JSONL terminal event, tool intents, and model steps into `AgentRunResult`.
lookFor: Muse runs report 0 tokens because the JSONL stream carries no usage counts, so token totals undercount mixed-agent runs.
Muse tool calls carry names only with no argument detail, so the cli-hunt metric in the run totals stays 0 for Muse producers.

groups.title: Agent selection wiring
groups.why: The user asked to run eval producers and graders optionally in Muse Code [user request](source:s1).
groups.summary: Threads per-role agent choice plus the Muse model and key from CLI flags through the producer, both graders, the run summary, and the report.
lookFor: The `--sandbox` flag reaches only Cursor agents. A Muse producer always runs with `--yolo`, so sandbox and approval stay off for that role.

commits.subject: Eval: run producers and graders in Muse Code
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body: Adds --producer-agent/--grader-agent (cursor|musecode) plus --musecode-model. Muse runs go through headless muse exec with the key on stdin; graders run read-only.
